test: Forge V6 versus V5 — image-only A/B test

assessment.technical: All job stages passed and GLB round-trip verified.
assessment.observed: Slightly better fin and upper-body mass distinction, but no clean hard-surface body, canopy, intake or propulsion assemblies. Large-scale geometry remains organic and distorted.
assessment.conclusion: Improving the single input image alone did not solve Forge reconstruction. Additional triangle count is not a measure of visual fidelity.
assessment.next_test: Switch to multi-view silhouette/camera fitting on original engineered Forge mesh, or benchmark a different permissively-licensed multi-view 3D model; do not continue increasing marching-cubes resolution without new reconstruction evidence.
